aloha_body.xml.role: <body name='aloha_base'> fragment; contains the composite base inertial, the static chassis geoms, both arm chains and the wrist camera nested inside fl_link6 (it must move with the arm).

aloha_assets.xml.role: <asset> fragment with the 9 mesh declarations used by the body fragment; merge into the scene <asset> (absolute paths -> no meshdir dependency).

aloha_actuators.xml.role: <actuator> fragment: exactly 14 position actuators in action_14d_order; every attribute is explicit (no class=), so it composes with any scene <default>.

aloha_equalities.xml.role: <equality> fragment with the two gripper mimic constraints.

aloha_contacts.xml.role: <contact> fragment with the self-collision exclusions (base<->shoulder plus all intra-arm pairs); WITHOUT it the probe's contact trace is not reproducible (see measured_basis: 5.7 kN spurious force at the home pose).

at_closed_gripper_command.note: hull collision between the two finger meshes blocks the closed end and breaks the gripper equality, which is why the finger pair is excluded.

aloha_cameras.xml.role: <camera> fragment for the two world-fixed cameras (head/front); the wrist camera cannot be here because it is a child of fl_link6.

aloha_cwmj_v3.xml.role: the same fragments assembled into one compilable model; the audit numbers are read back from this model.

fragments.composition_note: v3.1: `fragments` now points at the v3 repaired fragments in /mnt/relaydata/lingbot-tactile-lab/work/cwmj_aloha_builder_v3 (the v3 contract's `fragments` block pointed at the v2 files -- see quirk_note). The v3 body fragment replaces the collision geoms of ['fl_link3','fl_link5','fr_link1','fr_link3','fr_link4'] with 6 chunked convex parts each; the mesh assets of those parts are absolute paths in aloha_assets.xml. aloha_equalities.xml and aloha_contacts.xml are byte-identical to v2; the actuator fragment differs only in the finger-limit hardening already present in v2.

replaces_v3_fragments.note: the v2 pointers the v3 contract carried (defect); kept here for the diff

mount.base_frame: MuJoCo world == ALOHA URDF root frame (aloha_base pos=0 quat=1 0 0 0)

robottwin_world_to_scene.derivation: scene frame := ALOHA URDF root frame, welded at the MuJoCo world origin with identity orientation (aloha_base pos=0 quat=1 0 0 0). RoboTwin places that same frame at robot_pose=(0,-0.65,0) with a +90 deg yaw about world +z, therefore p_base = Rz(-90 deg) @ (p_robotwin_world - (0,-0.65,0)) and a direction d_base = Rz(-90 deg) @ d_world; rotations compose as R_base = Rz(-90)^T @ R_world.

cross_check.verdict: FK mount vs config camera residual is 0.077 m for the adopted reading, 0.349 m for yaw=0 and 2.112 m for the roll-90 mis-reading; only the adopted reading is within any plausible mount offset, so the world->base transform stands. The residual itself is the mount-to-optical-centre offset and is reported, not removed.

mount.note: the probe scene must keep aloha_base at the world origin (identity) or the cameras must be re-derived; the controller is agnostic to the base placement.

arm_joints.range_source: URDF <limit lower=-10 upper=10> (placeholder limits, see limits_note)

limits_note: The URDF declares +-10 rad on all six axes of every arm: ALOHA's real mechanical limits are NOT in this checkout (no joint_limits in curobo_left.yml/curobo_right.yml, only retract_config), so they are not invented here. +-10 rad is exactly what RoboTwin/SAPIEN consumes, so it preserves the source semantics; it is a KNOWN EVIDENCE GAP for any motion that would exceed the physical range. The probe must add its own software limits.

robotwin_map.then: drive_target = real_m * joint[1] + joint[2] with joint[1]=1, joint[2]=0

mujoco_map_used.formula: clip(-0.01 + 0.055 * g, -0.01, 0.04765)  # v2: no clip to the joint range
mujoco_map_used.negative_target_policy: kept as a preload: the joint limit keeps the finger at >= 0 while the position actuator applies kp*(target-q), so the closed end keeps the SAPIEN squeeze (measured +10 N per finger, see probes.gripper_preload_pilot)

blind_zone.blind_zone_note: v2: every g in [0, 1] maps to a distinct target (no blind zone).

gripper.open_reference_source: curobo_left.yml lock_joints/retract_config use 0.04 m as the open gripper value (0.04 -> g = 0.9091 by the map above).

mimic.note: fl_joint8/fr_joint8 axes are the negative of fl_joint7/fr_joint7, so equal qpos values mean a symmetric finger motion (same as the SAPIEN mimic).
mimic.nq_note: nq=16 because both fingers keep a DoF; the two follower DoF are constrained by equality, so 14 commands fully determine the state.

physics.note: the composed probe scene owns <option>; these are the values used for the audit compile and the measured response.
physics.geom_friction_source: not set by the robot fragments -> the scene <default> governs contact friction (documented so the probe can choose it once).

citations.what: _entity_qf(): compute_passive_force(gravity=True, coriolis_and_centrifugal=True) then entity.set_qf(qf) -> the SAPIEN controller gets gravity+Coriolis feed-forward before every set_arm_joints/set_gripper
set_gripper: clip g to [0,1], eps rate limit (default 0.1), real=gripper_scale[0]+g*(scale[1]-scale[0]), drive_target=real*joint[1]+joint[2], drive_velocity_target=clip(drive_target-prev,-1,1)*0.05
gripper_bias=0.12 (TCP offset, not a control gain), gripper_scale=[-0.01,0.045]

gain_conversion.units: N/m, N*s/m (PhysX drive for a prismatic joint; same functional form force = k*(target-pos) - c*vel)
gain_conversion.rate_limit: set_gripper eps=0.1 in normalised units per call (upward jumps only)

force_limit.note: robot.py never calls set_drive_force_limit / set_max_force; the PhysX default is used and CANNOT be verified in this checkout (SAPIEN not installed) -> marked UNVERIFIED, not assumed equal to MuJoCo.

target_range.note: the drive target is allowed outside the joint range; PhysX pushes into the joint limit, i.e. the negative end is a preload.

joint_range.enforced_by: PhysX joint limit from the URDF (robot.py does not disable limits)

gain_conversion.gravity_compensation: NO (no feed-forward; measured home sag 2.4e-3 rad)
gain_conversion.rate_limit: not modelled; helper `robotwin_gripper_eps_step` reproduces the SAPIEN eps=0.1 rule if a consumer needs it

target_range_v2.note: the command range now covers the SAPIEN drive-target range; the joint range is still enforced by the joint limit, so a negative command is a preload, not a position claim.

differences_that_remain: gravity/Coriolis feed-forward exists on the SAPIEN side and not on the MuJoCo side
SAPIEN has a drive velocity target and a per-call eps rate limit; MuJoCo has neither (only kv damping)
SAPIEN drive force limit is not specified in robot.py (PhysX default, unverified); MuJoCo uses ±100 N from the URDF
solver/integrator differ (PhysX TGS vs MuJoCo Newton, dt from the scene contract)

joint_limit_hardening.why: MuJoCo's default joint limit is soft: with the unclipped negative target the 10 N preload pushes the finger below the URDF lower limit. Measured penetration under the 10 N preload: 3.944 mm (MuJoCo default), 0.507 mm (solreflimit only), 0.045 mm (solreflimit + solimplimit, adopted). The joint range is therefore enforced to <=0.05 mm at the maximum preload.
joint_limit_hardening.note: solver settings only -- joint ranges, gains, force limits and the 14-D semantics are unchanged; v1 keeps the MuJoCo default.

actuators.type: position (MuJoCo position shortcut: force = kp*(ctrl - q) - kv*qdot)
actuators.gain_caveat: SAPIEN PD record; NOT assumed equivalent to MuJoCo gains. The measured step response is in probes.step_response.

collision_model.restricted_diagnostic_declaration: 轨迹不得标为无碰撞专家/不得作为安全专家数据（中文原文，见 41 卡 §2）。This model is NOT collision-free and must not be used as a safe-expert source. Trajectories produced with it may not be labelled 'collision-free'. The convex-hull collision proxies generate self-contacts (measured: see envelope) on pairs that the original engine never ignores; consumers must filter contacts by geom pair (finger<->object for grasp analysis) and treat arm-arm contacts as candidates, not as certified collisions. Validated contact-free scope: the home pose only (0 contacts); outside that, contacts are reported, not hidden.

sphere_proxy_feasibility.proxy: cuRobo collision spheres for arm links 1..6 (fingers keep the hull meshes)
sphere_proxy_feasibility.verdict: measured, not adopted: the sphere proxy still produces self-contacts in the probe-like envelope (see envelope.probe_like) and would change the finger/object contact geometry; adopting it needs a separate validation round.

collision_model.remedy_not_adopted_this_round: cuRobo's per-link collision-sphere sets (collision_aloha_left.yml holds 71 spheres for both arms; this model uses the per-arm config sets: 36 left / 33 right, 4 mm buffer) were implemented and measured as a hull replacement candidate (see collision_model.sphere_proxy_feasibility): they reduce but do not eliminate spurious self-contacts in the folded home neighbourhood, and they would change the finger/object contact geometry that the M1 probe used. Adopting them needs a separate validation round (out of scope here: 不改夹爪/资产).

candidate.type: chunked convex geometry (k-means face clusters -> convex hull per part)
candidate.geometric_basis: mesh-mesh contact generation assumes convexity, so a concave link is over-covered by the convex support function of its whole vertex set; replacing one implicit whole-link convex set with k part hulls keeps every source triangle inside some part (no under-report of a true surface intersection) while shrinking the over-coverage

repair.declaration: v3 仍属受限诊断模型：chunked convex parts 只消除**已测量**的过度覆盖，不改变“轨迹不得标为无碰撞专家/不得作为安全专家数据”的声明。

conversion_fidelity.method: regenerate MJCF from the URDF MjModel arrays and recompile; compare name by name

summary.verdict: 交付模型对每一个保留的 body / joint / geom 都复现了 URDF 编译结果（到 XML 的 12 位有效数字），残差只是浮点往返误差，不是建模选择引起的偏差。

triangle_inequality.culprit: box1_Link declares mass 1.499e-4 kg with principal inertias up to 1.66e-2 kg m^2
triangle_inequality.note: the violation comes from URDF data, not from the conversion; MuJoCo accepts it because the body is static (welded), and the arm-chain bodies are unaffected

sensitivity.verdict: aloha_base is welded to the world (no joint, no DOF); scaling its mass and inertia by 10 changes the arm trajectory by 8.882e-16 rad, i.e. it is a static mount mass and does NOT enter the arm dynamics.

static_base_evidence.why_it_is_static: aloha_base carries no joint and no freejoint: it is welded to the world, so it has no DOF and its mass/inertia never enter M(q). The composite mass is the sum of the URDF-declared inertials of the rigidly-fixed base chain (132.39 kg of which is the URDF's `inertial_link`); the arm chains are separate moving bodies whose masses match the URDF exactly (see conversion_fidelity).

mj_save_last_xml_fidelity.verdict: mj_saveLastXML is lossy (see numeric_drift); used only as a cross-check, NOT as the derivation path for the shipped fragments.

conclusion_boundary: 本任务完成的是：代码 + 单元测试 + 真实 CPU MuJoCo 编译/步进/渲染。**不是** GPU 仿真，**不是** 策略闭环。
14 维动作语义已保留并实测（顺序、执行器、mimic、阶跃响应），但**未**用 RoboTwin 专家轨迹回放/重定向验证（本任务不做轨迹回放）。
真实 ALOHA 机械限位在本 checkout 内不可得（URDF 全为 ±10 rad 占位），属已知证据缺口。
可视外观用 STL 碰撞网格（URDF 的 DAE 视觉网格 MuJoCo 不能加载）；移动底座躯干因此缺失，属视觉限制、不影响物理。
